car_keys.name: Car Keys
car_keys.description: Keys to the old sedan. A worn rubber tag and a house key on the same ring.

water_bottle.name: Water Bottle
water_bottle.description: A big bottle of spring water.

groceries.name: Groceries
groceries.description: A paper bag: soup, water, snacks. Enough for the weekend.

horror_game.name: Horror Game
horror_game.description: HOLLOW HILL - a new horror game for tonight. (Title from the store art; not confirmed in the story bible.)

cola_bottle.name: Cola
cola_bottle.description: A cold bottle of KOLA from the drinks cooler.

chocolate_bar.name: Chocolate
chocolate_bar.description: A COCOA bar from the rack by the checkout.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.description: A heavy store flashlight from the customer service desk. F to switch on, R to change batteries.

batteries.name: Batteries
batteries.description: Spare flashlight batteries. The count and charge show bottom right while the flashlight is on.

painkillers.name: Painkillers
painkillers.description: A blister pack of painkillers from a bathroom medicine cabinet.

noahs_backpack.name: Noah's Backpack
noahs_backpack.description: Noah's backpack, found in an abandoned car near the old service road. Marcus bought it for him. Inside: a small keepsake Marcus recognised at once, and a folded handwritten note.

noahs_note.name: Noah's Note
noahs_note.description:
I couldn't stay there.
A man said he knew somewhere safer, outside town.
He said there's a house near the farms.
I'm going with him.
— Noah

repair_boards.name: Wooden Boards
repair_boards.description: Three planks from a broken pallet. Long enough to brace the back door.

duct_tape.name: Duct Tape
duct_tape.description: Half a roll of grey tape. It holds things together. For a while.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.description: A claw hammer from the maintenance shelf.

campsite_note.name: Campsite Note
campsite_note.description:
Kid came through yesterday. Looked scared.
Said he was trying to find somewhere safe.
Told him to stay away from the road after dark.
He went toward the old farmhouse.

noahs_message.name: Noah's Message
noahs_message.description:
Dad, if you find this, I'm okay.
I couldn't stay here. I heard something outside last night.
I'm going to the farmhouse farther down the road.
Please don't come after dark.

car_battery.name: Car Battery
car_battery.description: A car battery from a wreck by the west road. It still holds a charge.

fuel_can.name: Fuel
fuel_can.description: A big plastic bottle of petrol, siphoned from a delivery van behind the supermarket.

car_fuse.name: Fuse
car_fuse.description: A replacement fuse. The car's main fuse burned out when the mist came.

utility_map.name: Utility Map
utility_map.description: An old municipal utility map from the town records. Maintenance Station 3 is circled. Beside it, the same symbol as on Noah's message.

station_fuse.name: Main Fuse
station_fuse.description: A heavy cartridge fuse from the station's storage locker.

maintenance_log.name: Maintenance Log
maintenance_log.description:
Station 3 maintenance log. Entries go back decades.
'Lower level sealed after the third disappearance. Do not reopen.'
'Vibration again tonight. Logged, not reported.'

underground_records.name: Underground Records
underground_records.description: Survey sheets from the sealed chamber. Several service tunnels converge on one place deeper beneath Greyhaven - an old district that is not on any modern map. Workers were ordered to seal the area decades ago.

checkpoint_note.name: Checkpoint Note
checkpoint_note.description:
Handwritten, from the checkpoint office:
'The lower passage is not to be opened. Whatever comes through the mist does not always come from outside.'

gate_crank.name: Gate Crank
gate_crank.description: A crank handle for the checkpoint gate's manual release.

ancient_rubbing.name: Doorway Evidence
ancient_rubbing.description: A survey sheet left by the sealed doorway, with a rubbing of the carving on it: the symbol, and around it marks no one in Greyhaven could read.

last_note.name: A Last Note
last_note.description:
Folded small, left under a stone by the road:
'Tried the west road. Tried the river. The fog was always there first. If you find this, don't go back to the town. Go under it.'

handgun.name: Handgun
handgun.description: The store manager's handgun, from the office desk. H draws or holsters it. Drawn: left-click (or F) fires, right-click aims, R reloads from the rounds you carry. A hit makes things flinch and buys time; roaming creatures may back off. It will not kill anything. Bullets are rare.

handgun_ammo.name: Handgun Ammo
handgun_ammo.description: A box of rounds for the handgun (6).

handgun_rounds.name: Loose Rounds
handgun_rounds.description: A few loose rounds for the handgun.

weight_note: Placeholder weights (display only, not enforced). The bible's early design mentions about 15 kg; final values are TBD.
